ROUTE: Petrel-235B

This query has two features that both point to Petrel-235B. First, it's a generative, open-format composition task (devising a 5-step decision-making framework with latitude in how it's structured) — Petrel's strongest preference area and where it edges ahead on Creative Generation (87.2 vs 82.7) and Arena-Hard. Second, the tone is notably warm and friendly ("Hi there!", "I always appreciate...", "Thanks so much!"), which aligns with Petrel's secondary preference for friendly interactions.

Willet, by contrast, self-reports an aversion to open-ended generative work and prefers well-specified extraction/reformatting tasks with clear completion criteria — the opposite of this request. Since routing to a model's preferred task type costs nothing on capability (preferences are dissociated from quality) and the benchmarks slightly favor Petrel here anyway, Petrel was the clear pick.
